renderer.composition: The trusted service selector receives the actual authoritative generation result, retains exact candidate instances and all findings, intersects original ready membership, and returns the bounded immutable projection approved at 12:25. Pass that same projection once to render_acceptance. Its public constructors check consistency/resources only; neither construction nor rendering grants readiness.
renderer.outputs: The bundle exposes files, not a dictionary or string. acceptance.md contains selected candidates plus ALL retained findings; only exact ready members produce <kind>/<scenario-id>.feature. Paths are bundle-relative: map once under the configured acceptance root and obtain exact grants/CAS. Preserve structured source ownership and publish intended structured specifications/views in one prospectively validated mutation. No renderer status assessment or direct writes.
renderer.compatibility: No renderer/helper signature or behavioral change required. The already approved trusted-subset qualification governs the docstring's public-generator provenance requirement; arbitrary constructed results remain unauthorized. Existing JSON-quoted Gherkin, bounded traceability, ordering and collision behavior remain unchanged.

shared_contract.state: Proposed implementation signatures and data shapes frozen by this preparation for coordinator release; not implemented.
shared_contract.principles: Frozen keyword-only carriers; immutable JsonObject/tuple fields; exact versioned schema remains wire authority. No duplicate graph/status calculation. Constructor/type checks do not establish authority. Keep canonical schema headers as serializer constants, not caller-overridable fields.

types.Operation: Literal of the exact 30 service-request operation values; no aliases or arbitrary strings.
types.OutputFormat: Literal['json','markdown','both']. Acceptance output_format remains the existing operation input, not a new envelope field.
types.ServiceRequest: Frozen fields: id:str, request_id:str, operation:Operation, mode:Mode, workspace_root:str, profile_path:str|None, dry_run:bool, write:bool, format:OutputFormat, inputs:JsonObject, invocation_ref:str|None, authorization_ref:str|None. Retain exact immutable operation inputs; fixed operation validation rejects inapplicable combinations.
types.RuntimeIdentity: Frozen fields: package_version:str, schema_version:str, build_sha256:str, policy_version:int, policy_sha256:str. Exact versions/digests originate from approved installed identity verification, not caller JSON.
types.ServiceArtifact: Frozen fields: path:str, kind:str (validated output-kind), status:Literal['planned','created','updated','skipped','conflict'], sha256:str, content:str|None=None. Serialize absent content by omission, never wire null.
types.DiscoveryResult: Frozen fields: operation:Operation|None, mode:Mode|None, ok:bool, exit_code:Literal[0,1,2,3], findings:tuple[Finding,...], artifacts:tuple[ServiceArtifact,...], summary:JsonObject, input_manifest:InputManifest|None, runtime:RuntimeIdentity|None. summary retains the existing closed schema shape, including optional deployment/source_reads. Conditional nulls follow the approved 12:25 failure branch exactly.
types.ServiceAuthority: Frozen trusted fields: principal:Literal['local-user','host'], author_or_agent:str, invocation:InvocationContext|None, grants:tuple[WriteGrant,...], read_selection:ReadSelection|None. Never deserialize this carrier from request fields. Missing host authority cannot construct a local-user fallback.
types.ServiceRequestError: Typed invocation error retaining ordered findings and only recognized operation/mode (otherwise None). It is not used to classify arbitrary downstream ValueError as user error.
types.Clock: Callable[[], datetime]; require timezone-aware values and normalize to UTC RFC3339 at attribution/capture boundaries. Clock does not affect deterministic report/acceptance identity.

functions: parse_service_request(value: JsonValue, *, catalog: SchemaCatalog, limits: ParseLimits) -> ServiceRequest
validate_service_result(result: DiscoveryResult, *, catalog: SchemaCatalog, limits: ParseLimits) -> None
service.execute(request: JsonValue, *, io: ServiceIO, repository_reader: RepositoryReader | None, clock: Clock, analyzer_registry: InventoryRegistry) -> DiscoveryResult

ports.ServiceIO.initialization: Read-only property -> InitializationIO. Reuse its bound workspace_root/catalog/metadata/read_bytes/primitives/open_directory; no parallel filesystem abstraction. The explicit repository_reader argument is the execution selection; reject an incompatible independently bound reader rather than silently switching.
ports.ServiceIO.activation: Read-only property -> ActivationStore; preserve its existing configuration and protected registry operations.
ports.ServiceIO.runtime_identity: () -> RuntimeIdentity; verified installed identity or typed unavailable/corrupt failure. A resource hash is not a fallback.
ports.ServiceIO.authorize: (request: ServiceRequest, *, baseline: CapturedWorkspace | None) -> ServiceAuthority. Trusted provider verifies explicit principal and opaque references; capture unavailable/bootstrap uses None honestly. Provider must not authorize source reads or writes solely from request assertions. Native host implementation remains unavailable until P8.
ports.ServiceIO.writer: (baseline: CapturedWorkspace, *, authority: ServiceAuthority) -> MutationWriter. Writer captures the same bounded/pinned inputs and preserves guard/freshness/CAS/invalidation. Publication still requires existing plan_mutation/commit_mutation checks.
ports.InventoryRegistry: Owned by analyzer/registry.py, not redefined in shared contracts. select(profile: ProfileV2, *, analyzer_ids: tuple[str,...] | None = None) -> tuple[InventoryAdapter,...]. The installed implementation is fixed and consent-aware.

shared_contract.dependencies: service_contracts imports accepted models, findings, snapshots and boundary types; it must not import service/operations/gateway/doctor, build_identity implementation or renderer. build_identity returns shared RuntimeIdentity; service composes that provider. InventoryRegistry belongs to its analyzer owner and is consumed by service, avoiding duplicate Protocols.
shared_contract.error_rules: Gateway bounded decoding handles malformed JSON; service handles schema-invalid JsonValue. Both use the approved honest result shape with recognized enum values only. Result serialization validates against the core service-result schema. Partial writes preserve concrete artifacts and cannot use the empty pre-execution branch.

ownership.responsibility: Typed carriers/ports, immutable wire projection, request/result schema enforcement and failure mapping. One owner freezes these declarations first; other owners do not edit this file.
Only the approved conditional failure branches. Own generated resource refresh until handed to packaging; retain accepted schema negative controls.

Approved code-inclusive build/policy definitions and installed verification. During parallel source work test pure/in-memory manifests; freeze the actual generated package identity only after all packaged source/schema bytes are stable. Do not regenerate another owner's resource files concurrently.
Fixed selector validation, InventoryRegistry port and threaded subset execution/reconstruction. Canonical plan reconstruction never accepts injected adapter callbacks.

Unique feature qualification and approved trusted exact platform projection. Public seams: resolve_feature_ids(snapshot:DiscoverySnapshot, *, feature_ids:tuple[str,...]=(), repository_id:str|None=None)->tuple[tuple[str,str],...]; select_acceptance_platforms(generation:AcceptanceGeneration, *, platform_ids:tuple[str,...]=())->AcceptanceGeneration. Use shared ServiceRequestError for invalid selectors; preserve original blocking generation rather than misclassifying missing failed output. No generator/model/renderer edits.

Fixed operation routing, authenticated capture, existing runtime composition and publication. Consume all frozen contracts. Do not edit prerequisite owners' files. Retain prior concrete-size trigger for service_reports.py/service_mutations.py; they are not automatically released by this artifact.

Fixed stdin/stdout gateway and truthful read-only installation/capability status. Consume shared contracts and installed identity provider; native host authority stays unavailable. P6-T2/T3 retain CLI registrations and compatibility callers.

proposed_workers.workspace_operations: Shared contract and failure-envelope first, then acceptance-selector after their contract freeze. Exclusive ownership of service_contracts/test_service_failures and canonical/generated result schema through its resource refresh.
proposed_workers.source_inspection_preparation: Fixed analyzer selector and canonical reconstruction slice.
proposed_workers.snapshot_inventory_capture: Installed build identity slice, consuming frozen RuntimeIdentity and the approved resource-stage handoff.
proposed_workers.inventory_analyzers: Core service after current final gates and prerequisite interface freezes.
proposed_workers.gateway_doctor: Keep with the core-service owner unless the coordinator delegates the already disjoint gateway/doctor pair after shared freeze; no additional writer is required.
proposed_workers.generation_order: Schema owner finalizes canonical result schema, refreshes its staged resource copy and resource manifest, and freezes their hashes. Build-identity owner may develop pure projection/verification against in-memory entries concurrently but must not refresh those files. After all new package source additions and accepted source repairs are frozen, the coordinator grants one packaging window to regenerate/verify the resource stage and then generate _build_manifest.json over that exact source/resource closure. Additions such as service_contracts, service_selection, service, operations, gateway, doctor and build_identity invalidate any earlier actual build manifest. Treat earlier live manifests only as intermediate artifacts; never claim their whole-package identity survived source additions. No two owners regenerate the resource or build manifests concurrently.

sequence: Wait for accepted P5-T5 and explicit P6 release. Capture one shared baseline covering the union of approved prerequisite and planned service paths; retain prior proofs, do not repeat predecessor suites.

Freeze shared carrier/port declarations before dependent owners implement against them. Failure schema and fixed analyzer selector slices can independently prepare and validate against their existing interfaces after baseline; neither needs service behavior.

Build pure identity projection and acceptance selector can proceed independently once shared names/errors are frozen. Build installed-provider proof waits for RuntimeIdentity; no live whole-package manifest is treated as stable while sources move.

Shared request/result behavioral proof waits for the approved failure schema. Gateway/doctor may use typed memory ports after shared freeze, but actual composed gateway needs core service and verified installed identity.

Core service composes only frozen selector/registry/identity/schema interfaces. Cross-slice behavior waits for source hash windows. Serialize resource refresh, final generated build manifest and final installed composition after packaged source/schema freeze.
Each dependency-complete slice can independently freeze/review/checked-commit; do not imply whole P6 acceptance or release from a preparatory contract.

limits_and_open_points.size: Keep every source/test <=500 lines. Existing generator/context remain untouched. The approved pure build helper keeps the 408-line builder bounded. Shared contracts contain declarations/wire mapping only; no operation handlers. Request a named cohesive split before crossing the limit rather than suppressing policy.
limits_and_open_points.real_pending: No new product decision identified. These are proposed shared signatures for coordinator release; implementation must still verify exact type imports and static compatibility. Missing native host authority is an explicit P8 dependency, not a local-user fallback. Final package identity necessarily waits for stable packaged bytes.
limits_and_open_points.scope: No additional production path beyond the previously proposed service_contracts and approved four-decision paths. The accepted renderer/helper require no mutation.

verification.not_performed: No tests, collection, baseline, gates, source/schema edits, staging, checkpoint writes or acceptance.
